table.name: TLGNR_DELIV_NOTE_SAREA_TEXT_BS
table.description: Texts which are meant to be configurable by the administrator, for example for PDF documents. New texts require a release (identifiers are hardcoded into the application).

column.name: TEXT_CD
column.description: Text code identifier. When defining keys its recommended to follow a hierarchical concept such as module.area.attribute.case, for example: pdf.deliverynote.chromat.1

column.name: SORG_CD
column.description: FK tlgnr_sorg_bs. Part of the logical identifier. The Sales Organisation of this Sales Areas, e.g. S101, S128, S160, ...

column.name: DISTRIBUTION_CHANNEL
column.description: Part of the logical identifier. The Distribution Channel of this Sales Area, e.g. 10=Domestic, 20=Export

column.name: DIVISION_CD
column.description: Part of the logical identifier. The Division of this Sales Area, e.g. 10=Cement, 11=AFR (Alternative Fuel and Raw Materials), 12=Mineral Components, 13=trading cemetitious, 50=Aggregates, 60=Concrete, 81=OPSo (Waste trading)

column.name: DELIVERY_TYPE_CD
column.description: FK tlgnr_delivery_type_bs. Code of the Reference Data.

column.name: PLACEHOLDER_COUNT
column.description: Number of placeholders of type {n} which must be present in the localized text. If a message is parsed which allows placeholders, java.text.MessageFormat is used. Therefore single quotes must be escaped, analog to fmt:message. This field could be used for validation in an advanced UI.

column.name: CTL_ACT_CD
column.description: Active Flag. When new data is entered, only reference data with active flag are available for selection normally.
